entities.summary: Denis Glinin (b. 1971-10-21, Lviv) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lviv and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, composers & musicians, europe.
